suite: Suite PR #557 (Gas Processing Studio Full precision switch, stacked on #554)

advanced.append: Read the figures in the Gas Processing Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
advanced.why: The Dew point tab rounds the chain to 1 decimal against tolerances of 5e-7 to 1e-4.
